ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Hermes uses the camera to take photos for your messages and to scan pairing codes (QR).
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Hermes uses the microphone so you can dictate messages. The recording is only used for speech recognition.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Hermes uses your device's speech recognition to turn dictation into text.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Hermes needs access to your photos to attach images to messages.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Hermes saves images from the chat to your photo library when you choose Save Image.
ios.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Hermes adds events to your calendar when you confirm it in the chat.
ios.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Hermes adds events to your calendar when you confirm it in the chat.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Hermes connects to your Hermes server or bridge on your local network.
